speaker: Basch; Ashe; Gabranth; Vaan; Reddas; no name shown; Rasler
line_text: Lord Rasler!? / You want revenge. You would have me use the Stone? / You would have me destroy the Empire? / Is this my duty? Is this what you want? / I cannot. / Why do you hesitate? / Take what is yours. / The Cryst is a blade. It was meant for you. Wield it! Avenge your father! / Yes, it was I who wore Basch's face— who cut down the Life of Dalmasca. / Lady Ashe! Your father's murderer is here! / You!? / And Reks! / I slew your king. I slew your country. Do these deeds not demand vengeance? / Yes. Good! Find your wrath! / Take up your sword! Fight, and serve those who died before you! / A Judge Magister there was... / Two years past, he took in his hand the Midlight Shard, stolen from Nabradia, and used it not knowing what he did... / and Nabudis was blown away. / Cid ordered this of him to learn the nethicite's true power. / That man swore never to let such terrible power be used again. He forsook his Judicer's plate, and his name. / Judge Zecht! / It's been too long, Gabranth. / Reach out your hand, Lady Ashe. / But remember, that which you must grasp is something beyond revenge, something greater than despair. / Something beyond our reach. Try as we might, Gabranth, history's chains bind us too tightly. / No, we cannot escape the past. / This man is living proof! / What is your past, Daughter of Dalmasca? Did you not swear revenge? / Do the dead not demand it? / Rasler. My prince. Our time was short. / Yet I know this: / You were not the kind to take base revenge! / The Rasler I knew is gone. / You are our saint, Ashelia B'nargin. You must use the nethicite. You must be the one to straighten history's weave! / I am no false saint for you to use! / Ashe... / In all Dalmasca's long history, not once did we rely on the Dusk Shard. / Our people resolved never to use it, though their need might be dire. / That was the Dalmasca I wanted back. / To use the Stone now would be to betray that. / I will destroy the Sun-cryst! / I will discard the Stone! / You claim no need of power? / What of your broken kingdom's shame? / The dead demand justice! / You're wrong. / What would change? I can't help my brother now. / My brother's gone. / He's dead! / Even with power, we cannot change what has passed. What is done, is done. / Yet without power, what future can you claim? What good a kingdom you cannot defend? / Then I will defend queen and kingdom both! / Hah! Defend? You? / You who failed Landis and Dalmasca? / What can shame hope to keep safe? / Your shield is shattered! / Your oaths poison those you would protect!

trigger: requested by 監督.シドの野望
speaker: Gabranth; Doctor Cid
line_text: So you, too, would leave your debts unpaid? / Enough of this! I can bear no more!

trigger: requested by 監督.シドの野望
speaker: Doctor Cid
line_text: You disappoint me, Gabranth. / He trusted you. / When you bared steel against the Princess, you foreswore your obligations to your emperor! / You shame yourself and make mockery of Lord Larsa's trust. / You are unfit to serve him as sword or shield. / And so I release you from that service. Your presence is neither required nor welcome.

trigger: requested by 監督.シドの野望
speaker: Basch
line_text: Gabranth!

trigger: requested by 監督.シドの野望
speaker: Balthier
line_text: You were only a tool of this Venat.

trigger: requested by 監督.シドの野望
speaker: Doctor Cid
line_text: How quaint. We are allies!

trigger: requested by 監督.シドの野望
speaker: Doctor Cid
line_text: The Occuria give men power as a master feeds his dog: it is meant to tame us. / How well you've resisted their wile.

trigger: requested by 監督.シドの野望
speaker: Doctor Cid
line_text: By turning your back on their stones, you give us free hand to write our own history.

trigger: requested by 監督.シドの野望
speaker: Ashe; Doctor Cid
line_text: And at what price? Dalmasca's freedom for your nethicite? / I shall not suffer you to have it. The Sun-cryst be damned! / Oh, be sure that it is! For what other purpose do you think you've brought us here?

trigger: requested by 監督.シドの野望
speaker: Doctor Cid
line_text: But, Milady, I would have you stay your Occurian sword! The Sun-cryst is glutted with Mist, and so precious a thing must not be squandered! / Let us use the Stone! Finish this, Venat!

trigger: requested by 監督.シドの野望
speaker: Doctor Cid
line_text: Shards of nethicite! Cocoon of the Sun-cryst! Spill forth your Mist upon this Ivalice!

trigger: requested by 監督.シドの野望
speaker: Doctor Cid
line_text: Let sea and sky be awash in it, that Bahamut may come and drink his fill!

trigger: requested by 監督.シドの野望
speaker: Doctor Cid; Balthier
line_text: And lo! How brightly burned their lanthorn! / Casts it back the shadow of Occurian design! Testament that Man's history shall be His alone! / You made your nethicite for this. / You mimic the Occuria's Stone for what? To become a god yourself? / On whose shoulders better to stand than those of the would-be gods!

trigger: requested by 監督.シドの野望
speaker: Doctor Cid
line_text: Such high hopes I once had...but you ran, and ran, and they with you! Alas, the hour of your return is late. / Come, Ffamran! Revel in the glory of my triumph!

trigger: requested by 監督.ガブラスボイスイベント1
speaker: Gabranth; no name shown
line_text: Hear me, Basch! Do not think killing the kingslayer will win you back your honor! / When you abandoned home and kin, your name was forever stained with blood!

trigger: requested by 監督.ガブラスボイスイベント1
speaker: Basch
line_text: Aye, this stain is mine to bear. / But I will bear it willingly, knowing that I did all that I could...for hope!

trigger: requested by 監督.ガブラスボイスイベント1
speaker: Gabranth
line_text: Preen and strut as you like! In the end, we are the same! / Blood-thirsting carrion birds, hell-bent on revenge!

speaker: ヴェーネス (script label, Venat)
line_text: The pleasure was all mine.

speaker: Balthier; Doctor Cid
line_text: Was there no other way? / Spend your pity elsewhere.

speaker: Doctor Cid
line_text: If you are so set on running, hadn't you best be off? / Fool of a pirate.
